cards.example_en: She raised money for a children's charity.
cards.example_zh: 她为一个儿童慈善机构筹集资金。

cards.example_en: My friends and I chat on the bus ride home.
cards.example_zh: 我和朋友们在回家的公交车上聊天。

cards.example_en: This T-shirt was really cheap.
cards.example_zh: 这件T恤真的很便宜。

cards.example_en: It is wrong to cheat in an exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试作弊是不对的。

cards.example_en: Check your answers before you hand in the paper.
cards.example_zh: 交卷之前先把答案检查一遍。

cards.example_en: We stood up to cheer for our team.
cards.example_zh: 我们站起来为自己的队伍加油。

cards.example_en: He put cheese on the bread for a quick lunch.
cards.example_zh: 他在面包上放了乳酪，当作一顿简单的午饭。

cards.example_en: Chemistry homework is due on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 化学作业周五要交。

cards.example_en: They play chess in the library at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 他们午饭时在图书馆下国际象棋。

cards.example_en: The chicken in the yard laid an egg this morning.
cards.example_zh: 院子里的鸡今天早上生了一枚蛋。

cards.example_en: The child held his father's hand in the crowd.
cards.example_zh: 孩子在人群中拉着爸爸的手。

cards.example_en: Many tourists visit China during the spring holiday.
cards.example_zh: 许多游客在春假期间来中国游玩。

cards.example_en: Chinese tea is served after meals at my grandparents' house.
cards.example_zh: 在爷爷奶奶家，饭后会上一壶中国茶。

cards.example_en: He ate a bag of chips at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 他午饭吃了一袋薯片。

cards.example_en: Dark chocolate is my favourite snack on cold days.
cards.example_zh: 黑巧克力是我在冷天最喜欢的零食。

cards.example_en: The menu offers a choice of rice or noodles.
cards.example_zh: 菜单提供米饭或面条的选择。

cards.example_en: Choose a story you really want to read tonight.
cards.example_zh: 选一个你今晚真正想读的故事。

cards.example_en: He is learning to use chopsticks.
cards.example_zh: 他在学用筷子。

cards.example_en: Taking out the rubbish is my daily chore.
cards.example_zh: 倒垃圾是我每天的家务。

cards.example_en: We hang lights on the tree at Christmas.
cards.example_zh: 圣诞节我们会在树上挂灯。

cards.example_en: We watched a comedy at the cinema last Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 上周六我们在电影院看了一部喜剧。

cards.example_en: She has a small circle of close friends at school.
cards.example_zh: 她在学校有一个由密友组成的小圈子。

cards.example_en: Every citizen can use the new public library.
cards.example_zh: 每位公民都可以使用这座新的公共图书馆。

cards.example_en: Noise in the city kept me awake last night.
cards.example_zh: 城市里的噪音让我昨晚一直没睡着。

cards.example_en: Our English class starts at eight.
cards.example_zh: 我们的英语课八点开始。

cards.example_en: This classic song still plays at our winter school dance.
cards.example_zh: 这首经典歌曲仍会在我们的冬季学校舞会上播放。

cards.example_en: My classmate helped me with maths.
cards.example_zh: 同学帮我学数学。

cards.example_en: Posters of maps cover the classroom walls.
cards.example_zh: 一张张地图海报贴满了教室的墙壁。

cards.example_en: His clean shirt was ready on the bed before the interview.
cards.example_zh: 面试前，他的干净衬衫已经放在床上。

cards.example_en: Her clear explanation helped me understand the map scale.
cards.example_zh: 她清楚的讲解帮我明白了地图的比例尺。

cards.example_en: A clever shortcut through the park gets us home faster.
cards.example_zh: 穿过公园的一条巧妙近路让我们更快到家。

cards.example_en: A loud click came from the broken door lock.
cards.example_zh: 坏掉的门锁发出一声很响的咔嗒声。

cards.example_en: The climate here is warm and dry.
cards.example_zh: 这里的气候温暖干燥。

cards.example_en: The children climb the hill behind our school.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们爬学校后面的那座小山。

cards.example_en: The kitchen clock stopped during the power cut.
cards.example_zh: 停电的时候，厨房的时钟停住了。

cards.example_en: The hotel is close to the beach.
cards.example_zh: 酒店靠近海滩。

cards.example_en: Wet clothes hung on the line behind the house.
cards.example_zh: 湿衣服晾在屋后的绳子上。

cards.example_en: A dark cloud moved across the sun.
cards.example_zh: 一团乌云遮住了太阳。

cards.example_en: It will be cloudy tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 明天会是多云。

cards.example_en: She joined the art club after seeing the posters.
cards.example_zh: 看到那些海报之后，她加入了美术俱乐部。

cards.example_en: The coach praised us for passing the ball well.
cards.example_zh: 教练夸我们传球传得很好。

cards.example_en: We walked along the coast and collected shells.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿着海岸走，还捡了些贝壳。

cards.example_en: She hung her coat by the door and sat down.
cards.example_zh: 她把外套挂在门边，然后坐了下来。

cards.example_en: Grandpa drinks coffee with milk every morning.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷每天早上都喝加牛奶的咖啡。

cards.example_en: I found a coin under the desk.
cards.example_zh: 我在书桌下发现一枚硬币。

cards.example_en: They kept training even though the weather was cold.
cards.example_zh: 即使天气寒冷，他们也一直在训练。

cards.example_en: I'll collect you from the station.
cards.example_zh: 我会在车站接您。

cards.example_en: My sister moved into college housing the week after graduation.
cards.example_zh: 姐姐毕业后的那个星期搬进了大学宿舍。

cards.example_en: The art room walls change colour whenever a new show goes up.
cards.example_zh: 每次有新展览，美术教室的墙就会换颜色。

cards.example_en: Come to my house after the football game.
cards.example_zh: 足球比赛结束后到我家来。

word.example_en: Cheer up. The sun will come out.
word.example_zh: 振作起来，太阳会出来的。

word.example_en: We visit our grandparents at Christmas.
word.example_zh: 我们在圣诞节去看祖父母。

word.example_en: We clean up the lab after class.
word.example_zh: 课后我们把实验室打扫干净。

word.example_en: The bank is close to the post office.
Our flat is close to the metro station.
word.example_zh: 我们的公寓接近地铁站。

word.example_en: Do not get close to the edge.
I have a cold, so I will rest today.
word.example_zh: 我得了感冒，所以今天休息。

word.example_en: Wear a coat so you do not catch a cold.
Come in and sit by the window.
Come on, we are almost there.
We come to the museum at nine.
A problem may come up during the trip.
The new magazine will come out on Monday.
word.example_zh: 新杂志将在星期一出版。
